checks: Six services started; Notification without a PostgreSQL DSN
Four distinct PostgreSQL system identifiers; each database has only its owner tables in public
Catalog separates numeric ID, hotel room number and string room_type; hotel IDs are UUID v4
Valid input violating room minimum duration returns business FailedPrecondition / HTTP 409
Actual outbox -> Kafka -> inbox delivery preserves numeric string room_id, room_number, room_type and UUID correlation/aggregate/key
Check-in API exposes the room snapshot delivered through Kafka
Idempotent replay and GET preserve the original snapshot after catalog changes; no duplicate event
PostgreSQL GiST: same door number in another hotel is independent; six concurrent bookings for one room yield one success
Availability returns numeric string room IDs and excludes occupied rooms
Check-in activation and cancellation request/reply complete through Kafka with booking UUIDs
Confirmed, activated and canceled events delivered to stdout with Russian texts and correlation UUIDs
Notification resumes committed offsets after graceful restart
Without inbox, a duplicate event emits a repeated notification with the same correlation-id
Kafka outage: booking commits to its own DB/outbox; recovery delivers the event to Check-in and Notification
Canceled room can be booked again with the same numeric room_id
